qaEvidence.spawnRationale: Canonical axiom literally names two concepts: 'vaporize builds vaporware; warehouse stores vaporware'. Foundry's 5 Kura-collection products (foundry-collective-status, foundry-tool-demand, foundry-tool-armory, tool-loadout-mapper, tool-request-ingress) are state-queries that want a thin warehouse CLI underneath rather than reaching into vaporize's 12-mode collapse executor. Multi-CLI product-lines are canonical pattern (xcrun + xcodebuild + xcodes; brew + brew bundle; ffmpeg + ffprobe + ffplay).
